findings.summary: Required deliverable docs/dev-notes/dev_ledr_g7_prompt_file_01.md is absent from the tree (no file exists at that path or any alternate). Spec §6 names it as a required deliverable carrying T1–T9 per-criterion evidence + §3 mutation matrix U1–U4 (实测) + 还原证据 + the constructed oversize corpus byte count, and §2 marks T7/T8/T9 as 缺一不可 with T7 requiring '⛔ 必须实跑并贴完整尾部输出'. Without the dev-note, T7 (full npx vitest run tail in a clean env, both counts ≥ baseline 27 files / 487 tests), T8 (mutation matrix U1–U4 attribution with restored-line evidence + git status --porcelain empty), and T9 (per-deletion necessity) are unverified. The only 'Test Files 27 passed' evidence in the tree belongs to the prior package (docs/dev-notes/dev_ledr_g6_result_timeout_01.md:79), and .dd-evidence/acceptance.json is also from g6 — neither is G7 evidence. The product code itself (src/generate.ts buildGenerateRoleArgv/spawnGenerateRole, src/tick-run.ts buildTriageArgv/spawnTriageRole, test/g7-prompt-file.test.ts T1–T6) is correct on inspection: both paths route the corpus through --prompt-file with byte-identical content (T3), preserve the --input schema guard (T4), clean up both temp files in a finally on success and failure (T5), assert on production-assembled deps (T6), and drop the positional corpus (T1/T2). But the package as a whole is incomplete because its decisive acceptance criteria cannot be verified without the mandated evidence file. As a read-only reviewer I cannot execute npx vitest run myself.
